rules.said: A percent is a part of every hundred: a% of b is b ÷ 100, times a.
The area of a square is its side times its side.

fact: 1 kg is 1000 grams (e.g. 3 kg = 3 × 1000 = 3000 grams)
fact: 1 km is 1000 metres (e.g. 3 km = 3 × 1000 = 3000 metres)
fact: 1 m is 100 cm (e.g. 3 metres = 3 × 100 = 300 cm)
fact: 1 hour is 60 minutes (e.g. 3 hours = 3 × 60 = 180 minutes)
fact: 1 week is 7 days (e.g. 3 weeks = 3 × 7 = 21 days)
fact: 1 dollar is 100 cents (e.g. 3 dollars = 3 × 100 = 300 cents)
